name: Te Awa Kairangi/Hutt Valley Community Environment Fund
summary: Annual grants for volunteer community groups restoring and protecting native ecosystems on public land in the Hutt Valley, covering plants, tools and pest plant and animal control, but not wages.

geography.label: Hutt Valley (Hutt City and Upper Hutt City areas)

reporting: A brief annual report on a council template each year, plus a possible site visit.

status.quote: Applications open - 9am Wednesday 1 July 2026 Applications close - 5pm Sunday 16 August 2026

opens.quote: Applications open - 9am Wednesday 1 July 2026 Applications close - 5pm Sunday 16 August 2026

deadline.quote: Applications open - 9am Wednesday 1 July 2026 Applications close - 5pm Sunday 16 August 2026

applicant_types.quote: Volunteer community groups and rōpū kaitiaki can apply for funding to support environmental projects

geography.quote: This funding covers projects in the Hutt Valley that fall within the area managed by Hutt City Council and Upper Hutt City Council.

access.quote: If you have a project in this area that fits the bill, apply to our fund for a grant.

window.quote: Applications open - 9am Wednesday 1 July 2026 Applications close - 5pm Sunday 16 August 2026

amount.quote: Groups can apply for up to $10,000 each year for up to two years

reporting.quote: Each year you will need to provide a brief annual report (we have a template for you to fill in) and we may also organise a site visit with you so you can show us how the allocated funds were spent and what was achieved.
